capabilities: Copy the current note or selected notes and folders to the clipboard
Expand copied context by link depth (Depth 0/1/2+)
Assemble and trim context sets in a Builder view
Save and reopen repeated context sets as named contexts
Format copied exports with context and item templates
disambiguation: Not an AI chat plugin; it only assembles and copies context for pasting into other AI tools.
extras: Freemium: Context Pro adds media/PDF/Bases sources, dynamic groups, and heading filters; core features are free and mobile friendly. README notes copied content leaves Obsidian only when you paste it elsewhere.
problem: Assembling the right notes as context for an AI prompt by hand is slow and easy to get wrong; Obsidian has no built-in way to select and export that context.

relations.evidence: Smart Connections can help you find related notes. Smart Context packages the useful ones.
Clipboard-first: paste into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Smart Chat, or another AI tool

summary: Copies notes, folders, and linked context to the clipboard with depth control, so you can paste curated vault context into AI chat tools.
